Gertie Pye has a habit of being late. She is also prone to jealousy, frequently making unkind comments about Julia behind her back.

## History

Gertie Pye was a member of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). During a society meeting, she announced that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) planned to rent his fence to a medicine company for painted advertisements. Her announcement prompted a committee of girls to attempt, unsuccessfully, to talk Judson out of his plan.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gertie-pye--jane-andrews.md)

Gertie and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) both serve on the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). During a meeting of the society, Gertie alerts the members that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) intends to rent his fence for painted medicine advertisements, which prompts a committee of girls to intervene.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), +2 more_
